scope: Fresh structured binary pictures shared across three demos and one query; independent per-pair D4, palette and unique crop; canonical drawing only in validate()
known_limitations: Structured pictures use paths, rectangle outlines, filled blocks and staircase strokes; not arbitrary natural or hand-drawn pictures
Native random picture sides 12..30 extend the canonical fixed 20x20 picture; no claim of matching perceptual difficulty
Single generate() calls draw independent pictures; use generate_episode() or the context-aware builder for training
Verifier is conditioned on a supplied demonstration output, not the archived fixed-template transform for new pictures
Unique placement and colour interpretation are enforced; symmetric or very small ambiguous crop controls can be rejected
Bounded split-compatible crop sampling can exhaust and be reported as a shortfall; no duplicate padding
constraints: All seven canonical fixtures reconstructed exactly; archived reference also matches all seven
1000 independent episodes, seeds 20000..20999: all 4000 pairs pass the independent demonstration-conditioned string matcher
1000 distinct native pictures under D4/palette equivalence; zero canonical-picture reuse; canonical access disabled during fresh-generation audit
2310 boundary-touching and 1690 strictly internal crops; 826 crops invert the full picture minority/majority relation
Builder stores each query with its original three demonstrations; checks shared context after all eight D4 variants
Picture and all crop equivalence hashes must share one deterministic split; both training and validation paths exercised
Incorrect answers and queries from unrelated pictures are rejected; changing query answers cannot alter verifier predictions
45 regression tests passed before registration; source hashes and new registered seed checks run again afterward
